metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: live panes, bands and status lines built on function hooks.

plugins.name: subagents-monitor
plugins.description: Live side pane listing the session's subagents: status, elapsed and working time, model, effort and estimated cost.

plugins.name: secret-mask
plugins.description: Masks secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords, private keys) in the transcript; hover a masked value to reveal it.

plugins.name: tools-usage
plugins.description: Side pane listing the tools used in the session (built-in, MCP, skill, agent, plugin, hook) with calls and token consumption.
